'''Adam Piper''' (also published as '''Adam K. Piper''') is a Star Wars CCG player. He posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1997<ref name="list-18781">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/18781.html? swccg-discussion message #18781], Adam K. Piper (1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000111063430/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/18781.html? Internet Archive]</ref> and played at [[2000 DragonCon Open]] on 30 June 2000 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor ops]], according to Brandon Baity's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d967">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-lordjaden-s-dragoncon-sw-open-treportd967/ lordjaden-s-dragoncon-sw-open-treport], DeckTech (Brandon "Lord Jaden" Baity, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-lordjaden-s-dragoncon-sw-open-treportd967/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
